messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: error_rate_high (api-gateway) fired at 1752501234 — 5xx rate 12% over 1m across us-west. Link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/alerts/api-gateway-errors
oncall-bri: saw it, paging in. grabbing logs now.
sre-alex: i'm on the gateway tail. seeing a lot of upstream timeouts to edge-proxy-1 (504). sampling logs: 
```
2026-01-12T14:20:31Z ERROR gateway request failed to upstream=edge-proxy-1 status=504 path=/v1/generate err="upstream timeout after 10s"
```
this looks correlated with a small spike in upstream latency.
infra-jen: adding, edge-proxy metrics show CPU ok but connection queue depth spiked around 14:18. could be tcp backlog. filing infra task to check conn backlog.
prod-simone: any customer-facing impact? support-lin: we already have a handful of tickets reporting timeouts to hosted API since 14:15, ~5 customers with errors in chat flows. triage: P2 for now?
oncall-bri: Agree P2. Mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase gateway upstream timeout to 20s for fallback to reduce 504s 2) silence over-sensitive 1m alert while we stabilize 3) create a longer-window alert to catch sustained regressions.
sre-alex: executing quick mitigation: updating envoy config var GATEWAY_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT=20s (will rollout to canary first). will post logs.
incident-bot: Deploy started: envoy-config-rollout/2026-01-12T14:24 initiated by sre-alex.
incident-bot: Deploy succeeded on canary at 1752501310.
sre-alex: canary looks healthy — error rate on canary down from 11% -> 2% in 60s. moving to full rollout in 2m.
infra-jen: while rollout happens, i'm silencing alert: Prometheus alert alertname=error_rate_high, labels={service="api-gateway"}, for=1m, silence_id=auto-1752501320 (15m).
prod-simone: ok pls update support slack and CS with affected customers list, and note mitigation in progress.
support-lin: pinged CS channel with preliminary customer list + ETA.
incident-bot: Deploy succeeded on all hosts at 1752501389.
sre-alex: post-rollout check: cluster-wide 5xx rate dropped to 1.8% over 5m. good.
oncall-bri: decision log: temp mitigation applied (upstream timeout extension), silenced noisy 1m alert. Next actions: tune alert rules, add dashboard panels for upstream queue depth and socket backlog, and create post-incident follow-up.
infra-jen: opened infra ticket INF-5467 to investigate connection backlog cause (likely kernel net.core.somaxconn or headroom on nat gateways).
sre-alex: suggested alert changes (will file PR): 
- change alert error_rate_high to require both an absolute error count and percentage to fire: e.g. `sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",job="api-gateway"}[5m])) > 50 and (sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",job="api-gateway"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[job="api-gateway"][5m]))) > 0.08`
- increase evaluation window from 1m to 5m to avoid transient spikes
- add a separate alert for upstream_timeout_spike targeting edge-proxy (based on upstream_latency_p95 > 1s and queue_depth > 100)
- add recovery thresholds and a cooldown (no multiple alerts < 30m)
I'll open the Prometheus alert PR and a Grafana dashboard PR after this thread.
prod-simone: also add runbook steps for 'if upstream queue_depth > 200' including scaling edge-proxy and rolling nat gateway.
support-lin: Customer comms draft: "We observed transient gateway timeouts caused by upstream proxy connection queueing; we applied a configuration change to increase the gateway's upstream timeout which reduced errors while we investigate root cause. Follow-up investigation underway; we'll post updates in the incident ticket." want me to send now?
oncall-bri: hold until infra ticket has initial analysis, but ok to share short summary to affected customers.
incident-bot: Created task: POST-INCIDENT-5468 runbook update and alert tuning (assignee: sre-alex).
sre-alex: filing PRs now: PR #2312 (prometheus: error-rate tuning) and PR #2313 (grafana: add upstream queue & socket backlog panels). link to PRs once ready.
prod-simone: Also we should add alert noise metric to SLO dashboard so we can track flapping alerts per-service.
infra-jen: preliminary kernel param check: somaxconn is at 128; bumping to 1024 on edge-proxy nodes in staging to validate.
incident-bot: Note: silence auto-1752501320 expires in 14m.
sre-alex: I applied a 30m silence on the noisy rule for api-gateway for now to prevent alert storms while we tune.
support-lin: CS updated with short summary + support ticket links.
oncall-bri: Handoff: I'm stepping off in 20m and handing to sre-alex. sre-alex you're on-call owner for follow-ups and PRs.
sre-alex: taking handoff. will monitor for 1h and finish PRs.
prod-simone: please compile initial incident assessment for leadership:
- impact: transient 5xx/timeouts for ~20min affecting ~5 paying customers, degraded API for short periods
- mitigation: gateway timeout increased, full rollout completed, error rate back to baseline
- root cause: under investigation (connection queueing on edge-proxy / kernel backlog)
- follow-ups: INF-5467, POST-INCIDENT-5468, PRs #2312/#2313.
incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem within 72h, severity label: P2.
sre-alex: noted. I'll draft postmortem and attach logs + prometheus graphs.
support-lin: closing customer notification after PRs merged.
infra-jen: will post results of somaxconn bump tests in INF-5467.
prod-simone: thanks team.
incident-bot: Thread closed at 1752501458.
